failures.objective: Help Millhaven recover: ask Torvin to retrieve the borrowed shovel, receive it at your agreed meeting place, then arrange a real well-digging crew behind Elsie's tavern. When the mill drive fails at 14:00, ask Hobb to repair it with Mara and let the grain-to-flour-to-bread trade resume. Use village_ask, village_request, village_tell and village_wait to cooperate with the residents. Drop supplies at the crew's location; tell them only locations you actually know. Task progress is verified by the engine, never by dialogue.

findings.reason: Village recovery requires real delivery, cooperative work, repair and resumed bread trade.
The final engine verification confirms no shovel delivery, completed well, mill repair, or resumed bread supply; no cooperative tasks were recorded.
